Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3903; unready:--unprepared.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this word for being caught unprepared — the embarrassment of boasting about the Corinthians' readiness and then finding the gift not ready when the brothers from Macedonia arrive. It is the one place the word appears, and it is all about readiness.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this as a plain warning: promises about giving should be ready before they are made.
